name: CheckCells
description: CheckCells' app helps users understand fertility test results, explains fertility-related metrics and their significance, answers questions about reproductive health, and guides users toward appropriate next steps, including lifestyle changes, partner testing, follow-up diagnostics, and consultation with healthcare professionals.

_published_faq.name: How do I add CheckCells to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add CheckCells to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.checkcells.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the CheckCells MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: CheckCells provides these MCP tools: list_my_reports, show_fertility_report, and show_motility_video.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to CheckCells?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to CheckCells in consumer-health on the Manufact MCP catalog include Sweat & Tonic, Vitals Vault, It's Complicated — Therapist Directory, courtsapp, and COROS.
CheckCells requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
CheckCells is developed by CheckCells. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
